---
title: "Monitoreo de Visitas - IMM"
format: 
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    theme: cosmo
---



```{r}
# Paquetes (descomentar si faltan)
# install.packages(c("dplyr","plotly","DT","crosstalk"))

library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

prueba_adrian <- readRDS("datos_listos.rds")

sd <- SharedData$new(prueba_adrian)
```

## Column {.sidebar}

```{r}


filter_select("f_mun", "Municipio", sd, ~Municipio)
filter_checkbox("f_turno", "Turno de Levantado", sd, ~Turno_levantado, inline = FALSE)

```

# Dispersión interactiva

```{r}
# Gráfico de barras interactivo
plot_ly(sd, 
        x = ~Municipio, 
        y = ~Visitados, 
        type = "bar", 
        name = "Visitados",
        marker = list(color = '#2c3e50')) %>%
  add_trace(y = ~Planificados, 
            name = "Planificados",
            marker = list(color = '#3498db')) %>%
  layout(barmode = 'group',
         xaxis = list(title = ""),
         yaxis = list(title = "Cantidad"),
         legend = list(orientation = 'h', y = -0.2))
```

# Tabla filtrable

```{r}
datatable(sd,
          extensions = "Buttons",
          options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", 
                         buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel", "print"),
                         pageLength = 10),
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Usa los filtros superiores para actualizar esta tabla automáticamente.")
```

# Resumen dinámico

```{r}
# Este resumen se actualiza al filtrar (gracias a crosstalk)
sd$data(withSelection = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    Registros = n(),
    Total_Planificados = sum(Planificados, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Visitados = sum(Visitados, na.rm = TRUE),
    Efectividad = round((sum(Visitados, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Planificados, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```
